research_question: Does background-aligned relative-depth dynamics plus rotation-compensated local expansion and image-space path intrusion provide parent-consistent pure-visual relative-risk headroom beyond its best single mechanism?

rgb_derived_inputs: optical flow and local affine expansion

representation.grid: horizontal image sector x image-height band x within-frame relative-depth quantile

alignment_contract.fit_domain: visual-static background surviving flow forward/backward, warp residual, dynamic-region and occlusion gates
alignment_contract.approach_rate: negative temporal log change of positive aligned depth; positive means approaching

arms.A3: A1 plus A2 plus frozen image-space path-intrusion fusion
arms.N0: A3 with temporal order reversed before all causal operations
arms.N1: A3 with depth frames shuffled across a different frozen sequence while RGB order remains unchanged
arms.N2: A3 with a pre-frozen wrong rotation warp intervention
arms.N3: A3 with background scale-shift alignment removed

fresh_source_contract.parent_unit: source-native sequence/session, never random frame or clip
required_capabilities: dynamic/occlusion identity or admissible label construction
at least three image regions per evaluated frame
fresh_source_contract.missing_policy: missing timestamp, truth, region identity or alignment support remains UNKNOWN and in the coverage denominator
fresh_source_contract.blocked_reason: the 2026-08-05 ledger is large and role-conflicted; no exact new two-source eight-parent cohort has yet passed route-specific capability, license, ancestry and prior-use exclusion
explicitly_not_fresh: all previously opened DepthART, RCLE, SATOM, TARO or scale-free outcomes
fresh_source_contract.advio_16: remains RCLE-reserved SEALED_UNSEEN and is not allocated to SVRF

metrics: relative-risk Spearman and within-frame pairwise ranking accuracy
false-clear rate where LOW_RISK means no high-risk evidence rather than safety

time_to_detection_contract.detection: second consecutive valid sample with approach_score >= 0.20 while evaluator truth remains APPROACHING

winner_rule.best_single_rule: among A0-A2 meeting parent-macro coverage >= 0.70 and false-block <= 0.15, minimize parent-macro false-clear, then maximize approach Macro-F1, then coverage; no eligible single arm makes O0 fail-close

external_basis.work: Align3R: Aligned Monocular Depth Estimation for Dynamic Videos
external_basis.bounded_relevance: supports temporal alignment as a real monocular-video depth problem; does not validate SVRF or its deterministic operator

external_basis.work: Video Depth Anything: Consistent Depth Estimation for Super-Long Videos
external_basis.bounded_relevance: supports scale-shift-consistent video depth as an active research direction; SVRF performs no training

external_basis.work: LightedDepth: Video Depth Estimation in Light of Limited Inference View Angles
external_basis.bounded_relevance: supports decoupling motion/flow and relative-depth alignment; it does not establish relative collision-risk validity

required_before_first_candidate_run: prior-use exclusion against the master ledger and route locks
exact N0-N3 intervention seeds and transforms
separate candidate/truth writers and empty exclusive artifact root

stopping_rule.pass: Only establishes bounded pure-visual representation headroom and permits a separately frozen learned-fusion or deployment proposal; no automatic execution.
stopping_rule.fail: FAIL / CLOSE_SVRF_O0 / NO_TRAINING. Do not rescue by increasing UNKNOWN, changing parents, retuning alignment/warp/fusion or adding IMU, ToF or metric height.

claim_ceiling: pre-outcome pure-visual representation protocol and mechanics only; no real O0 result, metric clearance, physical TTC, training, Android, product, safety or paper authority
